required_content_goals: 具体喜爱的家乡菜与理由

author_positive_body: In my hometown, traditional meals often bring seasonal vegetables to the family table. My favourite dish is the vegetable dumplings my grandmother makes. She uses whichever greens are fresh and teaches us to fold the wrappers together. I enjoy their flavour, but I value the conversation around the kitchen table even more. Would you like to visit us next Saturday? We could prepare the filling together, and you could try folding your own dumplings before sharing dinner with my family.
author_negative_body: Thank you for your message about travelling in China. I suggest visiting a large city because transport is convenient and there are many shops. You should check the weather before leaving and carry a small umbrella. It is also useful to keep your tickets in a safe place. If you have enough time, visit a museum and buy some postcards for your friends. I hope these suggestions will help you plan an enjoyable trip during the coming summer holiday.

author_positive_goal_support.evidence: seasonal vegetables，限定my hometown，未作全国绝对概括。
